metadata_hints.metric: Accuracy (% of problems solved), automatically verified final answers (exact integer match or SymPy-equivalent object), pass@1
metadata_hints.n_items_test: At release: "hundreds" of problems, no exact count in paper v1; Epoch dataset versions: 119 (10-22-24), 147 (11-06-24), 180 (11-26-24), 197 (12-04-24), 300 (02-28-25, final Tiers 1-3 = 290 private + 10 public). Tier 4 (separate, 06-30-25) = 50. v2 (2026-06-12) removed 5 Tier 1-3 problems.
metadata_hints.score_at_release_system: Best of six models (o1-preview, o1-mini, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Grok 2 Beta, Gemini 1.5 Pro 002); no per-model value given in v1 text
metadata_hints.score_at_release_setting: Models allowed to run Python and submit an answer (10,000-token code limit); evaluated on the then-existing subset; "no model achieving even a 2% success rate on the full benchmark"; only 4 problems solved by at least one model across repeated runs (5 runs on selected problems)
metadata_hints.human_baseline: none at release (problems estimated to take a specialist hours to days; qualitative Fields-medalist interviews). Later (2025-05-23): human competition on 23 problems, 8 teams of 4-5 (about 40 participants), 4.5 h with internet: average team 19%, union of teams 35%.
metadata_hints.lineage: FrontierMath Tiers 1-3 (Nov 2024, grown to 300 by Feb 2025) -> Tier 4 (50 problems, completed Jun 2025) -> FrontierMath v2 (2026-06-12, error-corrected: 123 Tier 1-3 problems corrected, 5 removed; Tier 4: 12 corrected, 7 removed).
metadata_hints.known_contamination_or_defects: v1 estimated ~10% critical error rate from blind second review of 25 problems (1 wrong answer, 3 missing hypotheses, 2 guessable). Duplicate problem found Feb 2025. OpenAI funding/access controversy (Jan 2025). 2026 AI-assisted review flagged fatal errors in about one third of problems (https://x.com/EpochAIResearch/status/2053995435870892048); v2 released 2026-06-12 addressed errors in 42% of problems (https://epoch.ai/frontiermath/tiers-1-4; https://epoch.ai/benchmarks/frontiermath-tiers-1-3 changelog).

metadata_hints.score_at_release_setting: few-shot chain-of-thought, Diamond set. Other Diamond baselines: GPT-3.5-turbo few-shot CoT 29.6; Llama-2-70B few-shot CoT 28.1. GPT-4 few-shot CoT on Main 39.7 / Extended 38.7.
metadata_hints.lineage: GPQA Extended (546) > Main (448) > Diamond (198), all released Nov 2023. No official successor version; later 'harder science QA' benchmarks (e.g., SuperGPQA 2025, Humanity's Last Exam 2025) are by other teams.
metadata_hints.known_contamination_or_defects: Label noise: D. Rein (NYU ARG blog, May 2024, https://wp.nyu.edu/arg/can-good-benchmarks-contain-mistakes/) - up to ~1/3 of Extended questions may contain mistakes; true fraction of objectively correct Diamond questions 'likely between 74% and 100%'. Epoch AI (G. Burnham, May 2025, https://epoch.ai/gradient-updates/gpqa-diamond-whats-left): rough estimate ~8% (15/198) invalid, '>=90% valid'. Contamination mitigations: canary string, encrypted release.

metadata_hints.metric: accuracy / test solve rate (exact match of final numeric answer after '####')
metadata_hints.n_items_test: 1,319 (test); train 7,473 (paper: '7.5K training problems and 1K test problems')
metadata_hints.score_at_release_system: GPT-3 175B fine-tuned generator + trained verifier (best-of-100 samples ranked by verifier), with calculator annotations
metadata_hints.score_at_release_setting: Computed from creators' released per-problem test solutions (742/1,319 marked correct): 175B verification 56.25, 175B fine-tuning 34.72, 6B verification 39.04, 6B fine-tuning 21.68. Paper reports these only in figures; launch blog: 'our system scored 55%' on the problems given to children
metadata_hints.lineage: Successors/variants: GSM-Hard (PAL, 2022-11), GSM1k (Scale AI, 2024-05), GSM-Symbolic (Apple, 2024-10), GSM8K-Platinum (MIT Madry lab, 2025; cleaned test set); Socratic-subquestion variant released with the dataset
metadata_hints.known_contamination_or_defects: GSM1k: accuracy drops up to 8% vs GSM8K, correlated with models' likelihood of generating GSM8K items (Zhang et al. 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00332); GSM8K-Platinum removed 110 flawed test questions and relabeled 10 (1,209 remain) (https://huggingface.co/datasets/madrylab/gsm8k-platinum, https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03461)
